_comment: Editor layout for GlobalFitModel. The local-fit list and the global parameters are both generic sections -- global_parameter_table already spans every fit and every registered out-of-fit group, which is strictly more than the hand-written table showed. Actions come from core/actions/model_actions.py, so nothing here needs GUI code.

sections.title: Local fits
sections.description: The fits whose residuals this global fit minimises together.
Fits whose residuals are minimised together. Select a row to remove it.

sections.label: Add
sections.description: A fit not yet included in this global fit.

buttons.label: ➖ Remove
buttons.description: Drop the selected row from the global fit.

buttons.label: 🗑 Clear
buttons.description: Remove every fit from the global fit.

sections.title: Global parameters
sections.description: Parameters shared across the local fits; link a local parameter to one of these to tie it across fits.

sections.label: New
sections.placeholder: name of a new global parameter
sections.description: Type a name, then press Add.

buttons.label: ➕ Add
buttons.description: Create a global parameter with the name above.
